name: currency-input
title: Currency Input
description: A composed currency input with inline currency symbol and currency selector dropdown. Built on Input and Select primitives.

migration.guide: API changed: import as namespace `import * as CurrencyInput from ...`, use `<CurrencyInput.Root />`. The `onChange` callback is split into `onValueChange` (amount) and `onCurrencyChange` (currency code). The `defaultCurrency` now takes a currency code string ('EUR') instead of a label. Dependencies changed: removed @headlessui/react, lucide-react, flag-icons; now uses Input + Select primitives. The lib/currency-input-utils file is no longer needed.

docs.lead: A composed currency input with inline currency symbol and currency selector dropdown. Built on Input and Select primitives.
docs.usage:
import * as CurrencyInput from "@/components/ui/currency-input"

<CurrencyInput.Root onValueChange={(amount) => console.log(amount)} />

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: All three input sizes: medium (default), small, and xsmall.

examples.title: With Form Field
examples.description: Currency input composed with FormField for consistent label and hint.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Amount"
  htmlFor="amount"
  required
  hint="Enter the transaction amount."
>
  <CurrencyInput.Root id="amount" />
</FormField.Root>

api.name: CurrencyInput.Root
api.description: The composed currency input component. Forwards ref to the underlying input element.

props.name: currencies
props.description: Available currencies: { code, symbol, label, icon? }
